nodes.responsibility: Immutable content-addressed incoming evidence

nodes.label: Event and Claim Ledger
nodes.responsibility: Append-only events, claims, evidence, decisions, and conflicts

nodes.label: Authority and Epistemic Policy
nodes.responsibility: Admit, reject, or dispute proposed state effects

nodes.label: Bitemporal State Projector
nodes.responsibility: Current, historical, as-known, and counterfactual replay views

nodes.label: Compression Candidate
nodes.responsibility: Create immutable representation versions with preservation/discard contracts

nodes.label: Concept and Procedure Store
nodes.responsibility: Reusable invariants, scopes, counterexamples, and reconstruction rules

nodes.label: Task Query
nodes.responsibility: Frozen query, temporal cutoffs, answer schema, and resource budget

nodes.label: Selective Component Planner
nodes.responsibility: Choose query-relevant components and dependency closure

nodes.label: Decompression
nodes.responsibility: Reconstruct lineage-bearing task state and explicit unknowns

nodes.label: Replaceable Solver
nodes.responsibility: Deterministic or model-backed task solver with capability descriptor

nodes.label: Frozen Evaluator
nodes.responsibility: Exact-answer evaluation is executable; independent reconstruction, provenance, capability, and cost evaluation remain separate partial mechanisms

nodes.label: Minimum-Sufficiency Ablator
nodes.responsibility: Exact small-set or labeled approximate component ablation

nodes.label: Failure Analysis
nodes.responsibility: Record and cluster failures conditional on solver/task/representation

nodes.label: Meta-Representation Profile
nodes.responsibility: Knowledge about representation strengths, failures, and costs

nodes.label: Representation Repair Gate
nodes.responsibility: Evaluate immutable candidate, promote explicitly, preserve rollback

nodes.label: Representation Candidate Proposer
nodes.responsibility: Query-blind candidate discovery under a frozen grammar and budget

nodes.label: Proposal-Policy Meta-Learning
nodes.responsibility: Use prior representation experience to improve future candidate search

nodes.label: Claim and Evidence Registry
nodes.responsibility: Scoped claims, support, contradictions, dependencies, falsifiers

nodes.label: Experiment Registry
nodes.responsibility: A-J protocols, artifacts, validity, and research dependencies
